      • DBInstanceName

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceName")
public String DBInstanceName

        The ID of the target instance. You can invoke the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        pgm-bp102g323jd4****

      • forceSwitch

        @NameInMap(value="ForceSwitch")
public String forceSwitch

        Set the value to 1, which specifies a forced switchover.

        example:

        1

      • resourceOwnerId

        @NameInMap(value="ResourceOwnerId")

      • switchTime

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchTime")

      • switchTimeMode

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchTimeMode")
public String switchTimeMode

        The switchover time mode for cloud migration.

        Set the value to 0, which specifies an immediate switchover.

        example:

        0
